scenarios.name: opponents-mountain-produces-red
scenarios.why: Same wording as Fellwar Stone on a land body: with p1 controlling a Mountain, activating Exotic Orchard adds exactly {R}.

scenarios.name: no-land-produces-nothing
scenarios.why: With no land anywhere, 'Add one mana of any color that a land an opponent controls could produce' has nothing to reflect: the pool must stay empty (CR 106.5). The engine's offer policy also omits a mana ability with no producible candidate (considerReflected requires ManaReflectedCandidates > 0), so the activate is asserted not offered -- the substance (no mana appears; nothing reflected) is what CR pins.
